versions.changelog:
Initial release of the 0bull-iphone-control skill.

- Drive a real rented iPhone via the 0bull MCP server: view screen, tap, swipe, type, run macros, or delegate narrow tasks to the on-phone agent.
- Requires live video connection with the phone; provides snapshot and OCR tools for reading the screen.
- Supports sending direct input events (tap, swipe, type) and device-level commands (open URL, set clipboard, control connectivity, etc).
- Includes tools to run workflows/macros and to task the on-device agent with specific actions.
- Features detailed usage guidance and cautions to prevent misuse or unexpected behavior.
